gloss: to make eye contact; eyes meet

definitions.gloss: to make eye contact; for eyes to meet
definitions.explanation: For two people to look at each other at the same time, resulting in mutual eye contact. Often implies a brief, sometimes significant moment.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{目|め}が{合|あ}った。
⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{知|し}らない→知る：00458_shiru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{目|め}が{合|あ}って、⟦{気|き}まずかった→気まずい：06536_kimazui⟧。
examples.english: I accidentally made eye contact with a stranger on the train, and it was awkward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{目|め}が{合|あ}う⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦しっぽ→しっぽ：09089_shippo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{振|ふ}って→振る：01983_furu⟧⟦{駆|か}け{寄|よ}って→駆け寄る：14681_kakeyoru⟧きた。
examples.english: When I made eye contact with the dog, it wagged its tail and ran over to me.

notes: An intransitive expression — the subject does not actively choose to make eye contact; rather, it happens mutually. The particle ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ marks the other person: ～⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{目|め}が{合|あ}う. Often used in romantic contexts to describe a meaningful first glance, or in everyday situations to describe accidental eye contact. Related expressions include ⟦{目|め}を{合|あ}わせる→目を合わせる：25647_mewoawaseru⟧ (to deliberately look someone in the eye) and ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧そらす (to look away).
